title: Why Hashrate Always Chases Cheap Electricity
hook: Miners chase cheap power, because power is the biggest bill.

scenes.narration: Electricity is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost.
When power costs rise or difficulty rises, less efficient machines are hit first.
A machine can still be running and be economically obsolete, if power eats too much of its revenue.

cta: What is your power cost? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Cheap electricity and efficient machines are what keep miners in the game.
